_comment: URL-liveness checker configuration. Consumed by scripts/url-liveness.py. Versioned + audit-traceable. Hosts compared case-insensitively; suffix-matched (e.g. 'gov.uk' matches 'www.gov.uk'). Update with a CHANGELOG entry and a one-line rationale per change. Note: 429 and 999 inside indeterminate_status_codes are intercepted earlier by the RATE_LIMITED/BOT_BLOCKED branches in url-liveness.py _classify() and never reach the indeterminate path — they are listed here only for completeness/parity with source-verify.py's (403,429,503,999) grouping; only 403 and 503 actually flow through the indeterminate branch.

legifrance.gouv.fr.reason: Cloudflare-fronted French gov site; datacenter-IP heuristic triggers 403 challenges on bursts

gov_suffix_default.reason: Deferential floor for any host matching .gov / .gov.<cc> / .gouv.<cc> / .gob.<cc> not otherwise overridden

excluded_hosts.reason: 999 permanent bot-block from datacenter IPs; never retry, never count toward score
alias of linkedin.com
IANA-reserved documentation placeholder used in updater.md / CHANGELOG examples — not a real source
OSM Overpass POST API endpoint (amenities-osm.md); a GET/HEAD 404s but the API is live — not a browseable page
